A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MagicMotion work. Their main text, equations, seven tables, twenty figures, and appendices are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original MagicBench and DAVIS evaluations, component and dataset ablations, and qualitative camera-control and video-editing experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains these original quantitative evaluations, ablations, and qualitative experiments, including the appendix results.

M1.justification: Trajectory ControlNet, progressive mask-to-box-to-sparse-box training, and the latent segmentation head and losses are unchanged. v3 explicitly names Wan2.1 1.3B in the main text, but Wan results and backbone information already appear in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions use MagicData, MagicBench, and DAVIS, with MeViS and MOSE in the dataset ablation. The appendix camera-motion, video-editing, and alternative-trajectory scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain Motion-I2V, ImageConductor, DragAnything, LeViTor, DragNUWA, SG-I2V, and Tora. Citation renumbering does not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, first-49-frame sampling, model-dependent temporal subsampling, training budgets, and Table 4 backbone settings remain unchanged. Removing the main-text training-preprocessing sentence changes documentation without specifying a replacement protocol.

E4.justification: The MagicData, progressive-training, and latent-segmentation-loss ablations and supplementary demonstrations are retained. v3's Appendix A relocates the existing Figure 8 ablation and its explanation from v2 Section 4.3.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Point-estimate reporting and the dataset-distribution summaries remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All 380 numerical result entries in Tables 1–3 and 5–7 match. The qualitative examples and plotted findings are also retained; relocating tables and the latent-loss example adds no results.

T1.justification: The latent representations, noising formulation, and diffusion and segmentation losses in Equations 1–3 are mathematically unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about three-level trajectory control, MagicData, MagicBench, and superior generation quality and control accuracy.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning shape preservation, progressive training, latent segmentation, and application capabilities remain unchanged. Appendix A restates the existing loss-ablation interpretation; no substantive limitations or failure conditions are newly identified.

D1.justification: v3 removes Section 4.1's explicit 49-frame, 480×720 training-preprocessing statement, while retaining the appendix's 48-frame/720p statement. It explicitly identifies the existing Wan backbone as Wan2.1 1.3B. Hardware, optimizer, inference settings, and resource-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 expands background citations with works including UniGen, MotionEditor, SimpleAR, BEVT, and SVFormer. These additions broaden the citation lists without substantially changing the paper's positioning relative to trajectory-control methods. Publication-metadata updates and consolidation of duplicate SAM2 references are bibliographic edits.

P1.justification: Localized edits add an introductory sentence, expand affiliations, add a funding acknowledgment, and clarify backbone wording. The existing qualitative loss-ablation discussion becomes Appendix A, subsequent appendices are relettered, and the MagicData distribution reference is corrected from Figure 20 to Figure 19.

P2.justification: Figure 3 shrinks from two columns to one, while Figure 8 is enlarged and moved into the appendix. Other existing figures and tables, including Tables 5–7, are repositioned. All twenty figures and seven tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The scientific account and supporting evidence remain unchanged. Explicit Wan naming, the corrected Figure 19 reference, and bibliographic cleanup improve local clarity, while the removed training-preprocessing sentence and smaller pipeline diagram offset some gains. The enlarged ablation figure improves visibility of existing evidence. These limited documentation and presentation changes leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
